name: atlascloud-ai-media
description: Browse 300+ Atlas Cloud models and run image, video, audio and transcription jobs from chat. Signs in with your own Atlas account — no API key to paste.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images, video and audio with 300+ models, billed to your own Atlas account
interface.longDescription: Browse the live Atlas Cloud model catalog and run image, video, audio and transcription jobs straight from chat. You sign in once in the browser with your Atlas account, so there is no API key to copy or paste and generation is billed to your own balance. Every billable call shows the model and price first and waits for your confirmation. Also bundles the Atlas Cloud API integration guide and prompt-craft skills for when you want to build Atlas into your own project.
